page.layout: One column of running text, with the page number at the top right. No margin notes. The catchword "Deus" sits at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: tur Spiritus a Deo in ministerium spiritus; quod est prorsus impium blasphemumque. At hoc non ita se habet, Apparens siquidem ex Filio, uti ex proprio lumine diuina illius natura naturaliter & induisse ex ipso mittitur ad creaturas. Hocque manifestum est ex iis, quae eadem Ecclesia in septima Ode Canonis in S. Ioannem Theologum, qui die octauo mensis Maij canitur ad Hirmum Dei condescensionem[?], ad ipsum Unigenitum Deum Verbum Patris concinens, ita decernit: Spiritus sanctus ex Patre absque principio procedens, & ex te induisse elucens, Unigenitum Verbum Dei Apostolis clamare denunciauit, Patrum Deus benedictus es. Et in una mystica oratione diuinae Missae sancti magni Basilii ad Deum Patrem orationem convertens hunc in modum de iam dicta ex lumine vero, Filio nempe, apparitione Spiritus sancti haec ad verbum edisserit: Absque principio, invisibilis, incomprehensibilis Pater domini nostri Iesu Christi, magni Dei, & Salvatoris nostri, qui est imago tuae bonitatis, sigillum aequale, in se ipso te Patrem ostendens, Verbum viuens, Deus verus, ante secula sapientia, vita, sanctificatio, virtus, lumen verum, ex quo Spiritus sanctus apparuit, veritatis Spiritus, adoptionis donum, futura hereditatis arrhabo. &c. Confiderandum porro est in his, quod Salvator noster, Deus atque homo existens, uti

page.notes: Transcribed from a scan of a single page. Long s is written as plain s throughout. Words I could not read with confidence: "condescensionem" (the word is shown with long-s-like letters and marked [?]), "hereditatis" (the printed letters are unclear and I have supplied the usual spelling). A small mark sits in the right margin beside the lines "Hocque manifestum" and "ita decernit"; it is not text and is not transcribed. Printed spelling "induisse" and "edisserit" follow the long-s forms as read. Possible printing error: "aqua-le" is printed with a line-end hyphen and is kept as "aqua-le" in the text: verify against the page.
